Genesis 1.text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God...
For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth...
By the word of the Lord were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

Genesis 2.text: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.
And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.

Genesis 3.text: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly.
And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed...
And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.
